follow-up time: Until serum β-hCG level became negative and menstrual cycles resumed (up to 8 weeks)
cohort: Patients with cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy
finding: The study identified anterior myometrium thickness at the scar and average diameter of the gestational sac or mass as independent risk factors for intraoperative hemorrhage during cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy treatment and developed a new clinical classification system based on these factors with recommended surgical strategy that resulted in high treatment success rates with minimal complications.
